findings.decision: Certification only. The statewide directory lists 11 office entries. A+ applies only to approved agency locations and describes evidence of compliance across screening, training and insurance. The public Freehold sample reports office services but gives no client denominator or dated survey results. The Paramus detail link returned 404.

Distinct from A+ certification. A real client/patient satisfaction survey exists, separate from its caregiver survey. An active account and consistently high ratings are prerequisites for the publishable quality rating. The public program description supplies no exact NJ office result with period, complete client-only denominator and score. EZ Review directs people to third-party review sites and can duplicate existing observations.
findings.rights: Sections 3.1 and 3.3 limit use to the customer and documented exports, prohibit unapproved monitoring/copying, and specify written customer authorization for disclosure. Section 5.2 reserves customer ownership of its data. No third-party office-score publication license identified.

findings.decision: Members nominate individual caregivers. The documented Visiting Angels Matawan NJ award in 2023 applies to its caregiver. Industry benchmarking is attributed to Activated Insights, so it provides no additional independent office-level score.

findings.publisher: Home Care & Hospice Association of New Jersey
findings.decision: November 2026 recognition event is based on nominated aides. Advocacy survey concerns PCA caregivers and solicited testimonials. Neither provides a dated agency-level client survey score or denominator.

possibleNextSource: An agency-authorized export with exact participating office, survey period, client-only responses and scoring rules covering every eligible response plus publish-and-score permission.
